states.title: Adversarial — newbie miss-tap bump → no undo → customer impact
files_inspected: app/Domain/Order/OrderStateMachine.php (per project memory — server-side state guard)

adversarial_challenges.challenge: Can a newbie chef miss-tap the Prêt CTA and irreversibly bump a wrong order?
adversarial_challenges.answer: YES. Single tap on .kds-card__cta (KdsOrderCard.vue:148-160) emits 'ready' → onCtaTap (KdsV2Grid.vue:324-346) emits 'change-status' upward → KitchenDisplaySystemComponent PATCHes the order. NO confirmation, NO undo (Wave V 2026-05-21), NO modal. Card transitions ACCEPT→PREPARING on first tap, PREPARING→PREPARED on second tap. Bottom row + small CTA = increased miss-tap risk on adjacent cards.

adversarial_challenges.challenge: Can a newbie chef accidentally bump via keyboard [A]-[H] shortcut?
adversarial_challenges.answer: YES. KdsV2Grid.onKey (line 270-290) listens for [A]-[H] case-insensitive → fires onCtaTap on the matching slot. NO confirmation. Mitigation: bumpLocalOnlyNotice prop + shortcut visible as `[A]` badge on card header (KdsOrderCard.vue:34) so the chef sees which slot maps to which order. But a typing-finger slip = irreversible.

adversarial_challenges.challenge: Does the server-side OrderStateMachine validate the transition and protect against accidental bump on a non-ready order?
adversarial_challenges.answer: YES at SERVER (per CLAUDE.md §7 frozen-zone OrderStateMachine + project memory). Duplicate PATCH on same order = 409 idempotency conflict OR InvalidTransition (KdsV2Grid.vue:314-317). But the FIRST bump on the WRONG order is NEVER server-blocked (the order IS in a valid bumpable state, the chef just picked the wrong one).
adversarial_challenges.severity: Inherent — server cannot protect against wrong-but-valid bump

adversarial_challenges.challenge: Is there a manager-only 'revert bump' affordance after the fact?
adversarial_challenges.answer: NOT ON KDS. Per cross-reference with B2-P6 findings (this same cycle): post-payment cancel is via PosOrdersTrackerComponent.confirmCancelOrder (POS surface, requires reason ≥3 chars). For PREPARED-but-not-collected/delivered, the manager must navigate from KDS → POS Tracker → cancel/refund flow. Newbie chef cannot self-revert.
adversarial_challenges.severity: P2 (workflow gap — recovery exists but not in KDS surface)

adversarial_challenges.challenge: Is there ANY KDS 'training mode' / sandbox / first-day walkthrough?
adversarial_challenges.answer: NONE detected. Grep on `training|mode_demo|sandbox` across resources/js/components/admin/kitchenDisplaySystem/ = ZERO hits. No 'demo' route variant. No coachmark/spotlight overlay. No tour library (driver.js/shepherd/intro.js — verified absent from package.json in B2-P6). LeCayenneRoleLandingUrlSeeder per memory maps Chef → KDS landing → newbie lands cold on live KDS.
adversarial_challenges.severity: P2 — same onboarding gap as POS (B2-P6-F03 sibling)

adversarial_challenges.challenge: What is the customer impact of a wrong-order bump?
adversarial_challenges.answer: Order N°X (wrong) is marked PREPARED → KDS removes it from the active board (kds-card--ready opacity 0.7 then refresh removes it) → OSS surface displays N°X as ready → customer at counter approaches → cashier hands over an order that was NOT actually prepared. Domino: real order N°Y is still PREPARING but chef forgot it. Net: 1 customer gets premature item / wrong item, 1 order goes cold. In dine-in (V1 disabled), worse — server brings out a half-cooked plate.

adversarial_challenges.challenge: Does the system warn against rapid-fire chains of bumps?
adversarial_challenges.answer: NO. Wave V explicitly removed the throttle because owner wanted rapid-fire. KdsV2Grid.vue:308-310 verbatim: 'enlève cette sécurité — je veux valider 3 commandes en même temps, puis 3 commandes livrées'. The trade is owner-conscious — this is NOT a defect, it is a feature decision.

findings.fix_hint: V1.0.X owner-conscious options (any of, not all): (a) RESTORE 1.5s undo window with batched-PATCH (preserve owner's rapid-fire by serializing per-order in a queue rather than canceling on next-click); (b) ADD opt-in 'newbie mode' user-preference flag → enables 2s undo + confirm modal for the first N shifts of a Chef role user.preferences.kds_safety_mode='newbie'|'expert'; (c) ADD manager-callable 'rollback last bump' button in KDS top bar that re-opens the most-recent PREPARED order created by current user within last 5 minutes; (d) cleanup orphan KdsUndoToast.vue + 4 i18n keys × 3 locales (tree hygiene). Owner-gate REQUIRED — do not silently re-add undo, since Wave V removal was explicit owner mandate.

findings.title: M-KDS-1 hardcoded `height: 462px` PERSISTS in KdsOrderCard.vue:297 — deterministic 56px overflow at 1920×1080 bottom row + scroll required inside card body for long-item orders
findings.details: KdsOrderCard.vue:294-299 cardStyle returns inline `height: '462px'`. KdsV2Grid grid-template-rows uses `repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))` but the child card refuses to shrink because of the inline 462px lock. Closed-form math (from M-KDS-1-board-grid-deep.json:77): 2 rows × 462 + 16 gap + 32 padding + 164 header chrome = 1136px > 1080px viewport → 56px overflow for the bottom row (independently corroborated by reports/audits/SUPER6_CHEF_RUSH_STRESS_2026-05-25.md:28). Inside-card body chrome: 6 stripe + 110 header + 60 footer = 176px chrome, leaving ~286px body usable. Sandwich Cayenne worst case (1 header + 4 variations + 5 extras + 3 sauces + 2 supplements + instruction 3-4 line wrap ≈ 18-20 rows × 24px = 480px) FORCES scroll. Wave U mitigated scrollbar discoverability (8px width + #6B7280 thumb + fade gradient at line 661-678) but root cause persists.
findings.impact: Chef rush 1s glance on bottom row at 1080p viewport: bottom 56px clipped → CTA possibly off-screen → chef misses entire bottom card. Long-item orders within card: chef bumps before reading scrolled-out customizations (allergen alert is in header so still seen, but supplement+exclusion lines may be off-screen). Compounds F01 risk — wrong-customizations bump is worse than wrong-order bump.
findings.fix_hint: Owner-gated proposal from M-KDS-1 deep finding (lines 152-155): drop hardcoded `height: 462px` from cardStyle + set `min-height: 0` to allow flex shrink + optional CSS clamp() on body max-height. Combine with Option A (5-col single-row ≤5 orders, 5-col 2-row 6-10 orders) so the layout adapts. Owner-gate is open — do not implement without countersign because Wave Q-3/Q-4 retraction history shows board-layout changes carry regression risk (M-KDS-5-allergen-badges-deep references Q-4 retraction NOOP + e2e regression spec).
